title: Moving the shopping boundaries in Shenzhen
description:
Ever since the resolution of COVID19, many Hong Kongers regularly travel to the neighboring city of Shenzhen to spend their weekends instead of staying in Hong Kong. Wang, D. (2004) found that 62% of respondents go to Shenzhen for shopping, which is more than half of any other travel purpose.

Further research discovered that the frequency of travel to Shenzhen varies across origin destinations from Hong Kong — New Territories (NT) residents undertake 1.02 visits/month, those from the Kowloon peninsula visit 0.64 times/month, and Hong Kong Islanders make 0.81 visits/month, indicating that NT residents visit the most frequently.
snippet: Improving the retail experience for Hong Kongers travelling North
